invariants.rationale: The method immediately returns for null orders, so at the exit point orders must be non-null.
If orders was empty, the method would have already returned 0.0, so it must be non-empty at exit.
Total price is the sum of non-negative prices, optionally with discounts, so the result is always non-negative.
If the method reaches the exit, orders is non-null and non-empty; as negative prices are unlikely, total will be positive.
Since isEmpty returned false paths lead here, orders must have at least one element at the exit point.
